9. Girdhari Lal vs Emperor reported in AIR 1925 (Oudh) 413, Sanmukhsingh and another vs King reported in AIR 1950 PC 31 are the decisions consistently held that the absence of complaint by Court cannot stand as a bar to a trial of any offence for forgery if the original alleged document is not used or given in evidence in the Court, This is for simple reason that ifthe original document alleged to be forged is not produced before the. Court it cannot express any opinion about the genuineness of the same.
